guidanceConsulted.query: responsive documentation tables and code blocks without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential headings, captioned tables with <th scope>, and visible focus outlines on focusable scroll regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, captioned .doc-table/.compat-table with <th scope='col|row'>, and focusable .table-wrap + <pre tabindex='0'> with :focus-visible outline.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive documentation tables and code blocks without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (inline-size, max-inline-size) and display: block on replaced elements like <iframe> to avoid overflow and baseline gaps.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, .example-embed iframe uses display: block and inline-size: 100%, and shared /public/styles.css manages table scrolling.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native semantic landmarks, lazy-loaded iframes with descriptive titles, and explicit rel='noopener' on external target='_blank' links.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: loading='lazy' with descriptive title + sandbox + referrerpolicy on the showcase iframe, and rel='noopener' on every external target='_blank' link.
